items_flat.title_en: Anthropic: Claude Designs Protein Binders Against Scorpion Neurotoxins
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude 設計對抗蝎子神經毒素的蛋白結合劑
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced that an internal Claude research model, operating largely autonomously over 64 hours from one initial prompt and four follow-ups developed with Citrini Research, generated 318,484 protein designs targeting five scorpion neurotoxins. Partners Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience lab-tested 211 designs; 17 met strict binding criteria (KD ≤1 µM, no off-target stickiness), with strongest hits against Mexican Cn2 in the single-digit nanomolar range. Anthropic released all designs and data but stated it has not confirmed neutralization in cells or animals and does not claim an antivenom.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布內部 Claude 研究模型在與 Citrini Research 合作的單一提示與四次後續指示下，於約 64 小時內主要自主運作，生成 318,484 個針對五種蝎子神經毒素的蛋白設計。Adaptyv Bio 與 Twist Bioscience 實驗室測試 211 個設計，17 個符合嚴格結合標準（KD ≤1 µM、無非目標黏著），最強針對墨西哥 Cn2 達個位數奈米摩爾親和力。Anthropic 公開所有設計與數據，但表示尚未在細胞或動物中確認中和效果，不宣稱已製成抗毒素。
items_flat.analysis_en: The result shows AI agents can rapidly generate and filter credible binder candidates for neglected diseases with low commercial incentives, compressing early design from months to days at typical hit rates (~18% for single-toxin designs). Whether these binders advance to safe, affordable therapeutics remains uncertain, as no cellular or animal neutralization data exist yet.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示 AI 代理能快速生成並篩選針對商業誘因低的被忽視疾病的可信結合劑候選，將早期設計從數月壓縮至數日，且命中率與常規蛋白設計相當（單毒素約 18%）。這些結合劑能否推進為安全、可負擔的治療藥物仍不確定，因尚無細胞或動物中和數據。
items_flat.quote: Claude’s design campaign produced 17 protein binders that each bind to one of four scorpion neurotoxins that are known to be dangerous to humans. ... We have not confirmed whether these binders neutralize scorpion venom in a cellular environment, so we do not claim to have produced an antivenom.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude 的設計活動產出 17 個蛋白結合劑，各自結合四種已知對人類危險的蝎子神經毒素之一。……我們尚未確認這些結合劑是否在細胞環境中中和蝎毒，因此不宣稱已製成抗毒素。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Expand Rosalind Life-Sciences Agents
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 收購 Orchestra Bio，擴展 Rosalind 生命科學代理
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced the acquisition of Orchestra Bio, a platform where people and AI agents coordinate complex drug-development programs by monitoring studies, tracking timelines, and flagging delays. The team and technology will integrate with Rosalind, OpenAI’s AI models and tools for life-sciences research (including GPT-Rosalind and Rosalind Workbench), which already serves customers such as Moderna and Novo Nordisk. Terms were not disclosed.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布收購 Orchestra Bio，該平台讓人與 AI 代理共同協調複雜的藥物開發專案，監控研究、追蹤時程並標示延遲。團隊與技術將整合進 Rosalind——OpenAI 的生命科學研究 AI 模型與工具（含 GPT-Rosalind 與 Rosalind Workbench），已服務 Moderna、Novo Nordisk 等客戶。交易條件未揭露。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal moves OpenAI deeper into operational agentic software for biopharma, pairing scientific reasoning models with workflow coordination that spans internal teams and external partners. Success will depend on how quickly the combined system reduces actual development timelines without introducing new coordination failures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易讓 OpenAI 更深入生物製藥的營運代理軟體，將科學推理模型與跨越內部團隊與外部夥伴的工作流程協調結合。成敗取決於整合系統能否實際縮短開發時程，而不引入新的協調失敗。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform that helps biopharma teams coordinate the complex process of drug development. We’re bringing Orchestra’s team and technology together with Rosalind, our AI models and tools for life sciences research.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 已收購 Orchestra Bio，這是一個協助生物製藥團隊協調複雜藥物開發過程的平台。我們將 Orchestra 的團隊與技術與 Rosalind——我們的生命科學研究 AI 模型與工具——結合在一起。

items_flat.title_en: SpaceX Q3 Results: Super Intelligence Revenue Hits $7.6B, Over Half of Total
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceX 第三季財報：Super Intelligence 營收達 76 億美元，占總營收過半
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceX reported unaudited Q3 2026 revenue of $14.6 billion (up 161% year-over-year) and net income of $4.4 billion. Its Super Intelligence segment (covering Grok, Cursor, Grok Bot, and neocloud compute) generated $7.56 billion, roughly 52% of total revenue and up more than ninefold, driven largely by cloud capacity rentals. Nameplate compute reached 1.7 GW; AI-related capital expenditure accounted for the majority of the $19.6 billion quarterly spend.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceX 報告未經審計的 2026 年第三季營收 146 億美元（年增 161%）、淨利 44 億美元。其 Super Intelligence 部門（涵蓋 Grok、Cursor、Grok Bot 與 neocloud 算力）產生 75.6 億美元，約占總營收 52%，年增逾九倍，主要由雲端算力出租驅動。名牌算力達 1.7 GW；AI 相關資本支出占當季 196 億美元支出的大部分。
items_flat.analysis_en: The numbers confirm SpaceX’s pivot toward AI infrastructure and software as its largest revenue line, with most AI income currently from renting compute rather than Grok product sales. Sustained profitability will depend on whether utilization of the expanding Colossus capacity keeps pace with the heavy ongoing capital outlays.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 數字確認 SpaceX 轉向 AI 基礎設施與軟體成為最大營收來源，目前多數 AI 收入來自出租算力而非 Grok 產品銷售。持續獲利取決於擴張中的 Colossus 算力利用率能否跟上沉重的持續資本支出。
items_flat.quote: Delivered revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% year-over-year, fueled by our Super Intelligence (SI) segment and accelerated growth in Connectivity.
items_flat.quote_zh: 實現營收 146 億美元，年增 161%，由我們的 Super Intelligence（SI）部門與連通性加速成長所帶動。

items_flat.title_en: Google Public Sector Launches Gemini for Government Services in Preview
items_flat.title_zh: Google Public Sector 推出政府服務版 Gemini（預覽）
items_flat.summary_en: Google Public Sector announced Gemini for government services in private preview, a purpose-built agentic platform for federal, state, and local agencies. It includes specialized skills for regulatory research, FOIA redaction, procurement, and expense auditing, plus secure connectors to systems of record, with governance controls. Early users include the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and the State of Missouri.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Public Sector 宣布政府服務版 Gemini 進入私人預覽，這是專為聯邦、州與地方政府設計的代理平台。包含法規研究、FOIA 遮黑、採購與費用稽核等專門技能，以及安全連接至既有系統，並附治理控制。早期使用者包括美國衛生與公眾服務部與密蘇里州。
items_flat.analysis_en: The offering packages Gemini agents with government-specific skills and connectors rather than a new foundation model, aiming to reduce administrative burden while inheriting existing identity and access controls. Real-world impact will hinge on how agencies handle citation accuracy, data residency, and the residual risk of agent errors in high-stakes workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此產品將 Gemini 代理搭配政府專用技能與連接器，而非新基礎模型，目標是減輕行政負擔並繼承既有身份與存取控制。實際影響取決於機構如何處理引用準確性、資料駐留，以及高風險工作流程中代理錯誤的殘餘風險。
items_flat.quote: This morning we launched Gemini for government services in private preview, a purpose-built platform engineered for the security, governance, and workflow complexity of public sector missions.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今早我們推出政府服務版 Gemini 私人預覽，這是專為公共部門任務的安全、治理與工作流程複雜度所設計的平台。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out Locked Chats in ChatGPT with PIN and Biometric Access
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 推出 Locked Chats，支援 PIN 與生物辨識
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI began rolling out Locked Chats, which move selected conversations out of regular history, pinned chats, and search into a protected space unlocked by a 4-digit account PIN (or Face ID/Touch ID/device unlock on mobile). New messages in locked chats update only the locked-section memory, not regular Memory. The feature does not add end-to-end encryption or change retention or model-improvement settings and is available across Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 開始推出 Locked Chats，將選定對話移出一般歷史、釘選與搜尋，進入需 4 位數帳號 PIN（行動裝置可用 Face ID/Touch ID/裝置解鎖）才能開啟的保護空間。鎖定後新訊息只更新鎖定區記憶，不影響一般 Memory。此功能不加端對端加密，也不改變保留或模型改進設定，適用 Free、Go、Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 與 Edu 方案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Locked Chats addresses shared-device and screen-sharing privacy needs but is a visibility control rather than a cryptographic safeguard; prior memory and retention policies remain unchanged. Its practical value will depend on user adoption and whether the separate memory boundary reduces unintended context leakage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Locked Chats 回應共用裝置與螢幕分享的隱私需求，但屬於可見性控制而非密碼學保護；先前記憶與保留政策維持不變。實際價值取決於使用者採用程度，以及獨立記憶邊界能否減少非預期的上下文外洩。
items_flat.quote: Keep sensitive conversations out of view with Locked Chats in ChatGPT. Move chats out of your regular history and search into a protected space you can unlock with a PIN on web and desktop, or a PIN, Face ID, Touch ID, or device unlock on supported mobile devices.
items_flat.quote_zh: 用 ChatGPT 的 Locked Chats 讓敏感對話不外露。將對話移出一般歷史與搜尋，進入受保護空間，網頁與桌面用 PIN 解鎖，支援的行動裝置可用 PIN、Face ID、Touch ID 或裝置解鎖。
